question: What evidence is sufficient to reserve, decline, or defer the requested @ifabrish-skills / @ifabrish namespace or package reservation for this claimant?
rationale: Code can provide the intake and reservation tools, but only staff can verify real-world ownership and safely assign namespace or package publishing trust.

options.title: Request clearer proof first
options.body: Ask the claimant for exact ClawHub URLs and public-safe evidence before any registry mutation.

options.title: Reserve after private verification
options.body: If staff has already verified ownership privately, use the admin reservation tooling and post a public-safe outcome.

options.title: Decline if proof remains absent
options.body: If the claimant cannot provide ownership evidence, close the claim without changing namespace ownership.

recommendation.title: Request clearer proof first
recommendation.body: Ask the claimant for exact ClawHub URLs and public-safe evidence before any registry mutation.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision affects namespace and package publishing trust, and CODEOWNERS routes the affected security-sensitive surfaces to this team.
